active_objective:
Generate a candidate that physically carries its complete reviewed production
dependency payload. Bind the graph and every bundled file independently, then
prove npm 10 and npm 11 install identical bytes from an empty cache with an
unreachable registry and zero external requests.
stop_condition: Stop S19-v2 if npm omits or rewrites bundled bytes, attempts a fetch, produces npm-version-specific payloads, or if exact byte equivalence cannot be independently established; stop the arc on unsafe package type, licensing ambiguity, provider, privacy, experiment, publication, deployment, customer, or assurance-transfer crossover.
